text:
AnitaP: Thanks for joining. Opening this thread for any leftover Qs on hiring, small team moves, and rollout timing.

MarcoL: For runtime, any ballpark on how many IC vs manager roles in the 30-seat plan?

AnitaP: Rough split: ~24 ICs, ~4 EMs, ~2 senior leadership/architect roles. That can flex a bit per tranche.

DanaC: If my team merges with another, will we see role cuts or just reporting changes?

AnitaP: Mostly reporting changes to reduce duplicated on-call/coordination. No planned headcount reductions. Managers will message impacted people this week.

PriyaK: Recruiting note: internal applicants get prioritized scheduling. Please mark reqs as "internal first" in Greenhouse.

OmarS: Any change to interview format for mid-senior infra? Heard about a trial loop.

MarcoL: Pilot loop: mid-level = 2 interviews (systems + collaboration), senior = full loop + short take-home micro-benchmark.

PeopleOpsBot: Promotion policy reminder: comp adjustments apply at approval date. Typical approval window ~26 days. DM PeopleOps for questions.

DanaC: Can leadership share a read-only tracker so managers can plan around approved vs tentative seats?

AnitaP: Yes, we'll publish a headcount tracker (org -> approved seats -> tranche) by next Tue. It will be read-only and updated weekly.

PriyaK: Also launching a limited referral uplift for critical infra hires: details in #recruiting later today.

AllHandsBot: Recording and slides: https://redwood/all-hands/2501234567. Follow-up doc will include manager comms checklist.

AnitaP: Thanks all. If you have private concerns about role changes, DM People or me. Closing in 48h unless more Qs.
